events.text: I'll verify the device-cap code on disk first, then run the local probe, deploy, and retire the old admin controls.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check git status, recent commits, branch
events.input: $ git status --short && echo "---" && git log -8 --oneline && echo "---BRANCH---" && git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD && echo "---REMOTE---" && git status -sb | head -5

events.text: The working tree has unrelated changes. I'll look only at the T-096 files to see what's actually committed.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check commit history of T-096 files
events.input: $ git log --oneline -20 -- cloud/migrations/0027_attendee_devices.sql cloud/src/index.ts cloud/admin-ui/admin.js cloud/src/settings.ts app/src/app/admin/admin-client.tsx; echo "=== DIFFSTAT vs HEAD for T-096 files ==="; git diff --stat HEAD -- cloud/ app/src/app/admin/ ; echo "=== unpushed commit ==="; git log origin/main..HEAD --oneline

events.name: Bash
events.head: Count device references in T-096 files
events.input: $ rg -n "device" cloud/migrations/0027_attendee_devices.sql cloud/src/settings.ts | head -40; echo "=== admin-client hits ==="; rg -c "device" app/src/app/admin/admin-client.tsx; echo "=== admin.js device hits ==="; rg -c "device" cloud/admin-ui/admin.js; echo "=== index.ts device hits ==="; rg -c "device" cloud/src/index.ts

events.text: The T-096 commit exists locally. Now I'll check whether it was pushed and whether the local admin retirement is actually in it.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check push state and local admin device lines
events.input: $ git merge-base --is-ancestor 63e5833 origin/main && echo "T-096 commit IS on origin/main" || echo "T-096 commit NOT pushed"; echo "=== local admin device lines ==="; rg -n "device" app/src/app/admin/admin-client.tsx; echo "=== in commit 63e5833? ==="; git show --stat 63e5833 | head -30

events.text: The code is committed and pushed. I need to check whether migration 0027 was applied and the Worker deployed. Let me look at the deploy history and the device-handling code.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Locate device handling and D1 config
events.input: $ rg -n "attendee_devices|device_cap|deviceHash|device_hash" cloud/src/index.ts | head -40; echo "=== wrangler config ==="; ls cloud/wrangler.toml cloud/wrangler.jsonc 2>/dev/null; rg -n "database_name|d1_databases" cloud/wrangler.toml cloud/wrangler.jsonc 2>/dev/null | head -20

events.text: The code is in place. Next I'll check the local dev server on :8790 and whether migration 0027 is applied remotely.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check local server and remote migration state
events.input: $ curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 8 http://localhost:8790/admin/ ; echo " <- local admin"; echo "=== remote migrations ==="; cd cloud && npx wrangler d1 migrations list revops-centre --remote 2>&1 | tail -25

events.name: Bash
events.head: List recent Worker deployments
events.input: $ cd cloud && npx wrangler deployments list 2>&1 | head -30

events.name: Bash
events.head: Verify device table and column on remote D1
events.input: $ cd cloud && npx wrangler d1 execute revops-centre --remote --command "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE name LIKE '%device%'; SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM pragma_table_info('attendees') WHERE name='device_cap';" 2>&1 | tail -30

events.text: The shell reset to the repo root. Re-running from there.
Deployments exist after the T-096 commit, but the list is truncated. Let me confirm the latest version and check the live admin bundle actually contains the Devices code.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check latest deploy and live bundle content
events.input: $ npx wrangler deployments list 2>&1 | rg -A2 "^Created" | tail -12; echo "=== live admin.js device refs ==="; curl -s --max-time 20 "https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev/admin/admin.js?v=check" | rg -c "saveDevCap|devCap|Devices" ; echo "=== live index device_cap via admin api (expect 401) ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" --max-time 15 "https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev/admin/api/attendees"

events.text: The live admin bundle returned no device matches. Let me see what that URL actually serves.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect live admin.js content
events.input: $ curl -s -D - --max-time 20 "https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev/admin/admin.js" -o /tmp/live-admin.js | head -15; echo "=== size ==="; wc -c /tmp/live-admin.js; echo "=== device grep ==="; rg -o "device[^\"' <]{0,30}" /tmp/live-admin.js | sort | uniq -c | head -20

events.text: The admin assets are behind auth. Let me find the local key and how the probe signs in.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Locate admin key and existing probes
events.input: $ ls -la ~/.config/tantra/ 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo "=== probe files mentioning devices ==="; rg -l "device" cloud/scripts/*.py workshop-plan/ops/*.py 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== local dev log tail ==="; ls -t ~/Library/Logs/revops-*.log 2>/dev/null | head -3
